property_summary: Whenever the on-chain randomness uint(keccak256(ts,difficulty))%2 equals 1, a correctly-funded play() call must succeed without reverting (the reference performs no external transfer on that branch), whereas the mutant enters the payout branch and reverts because its transfer of the fee to the bank fails; the test restricts the fuzz domain to randomness==1 and asserts the call succeeds.
change_summary: Change the win condition from `random == 0` to `random == 1` so the payout/reset happens on the opposite outcome.
